Professional Experience

April 2023 – Present: ICT Infracon LLP – Bangalore| Associate Software Engineer, India

Full Stack Software Engineer with strong experience in developing web applications using Angular, Javascript, Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring JPA and SQL. Proficient in building secure RESTful APIs, responsive user interfaces, and scalable backend systems. Adept at collaborating with cross- functional teams in Agile environments. Proven ability to improve system performance and deliver production-ready code for government and enterprise-level platforms.

Developed core modules using Java 17, Spring boot, Spring data JPA, Spring Cloud

framework.

Assisted in full-stack feature development, focusing on clean architecture and reusable

components.

Developed RESTful APIs using Spring REST.

Build and developed frontend components using Angular and TypeScript.

Built Angular-based UIs and managed backend logic with MS SQL Server.

Optimized frontend modules using Angular and TypeScript, enhancing the user experience of

a government portal by 30%.

Contributed to internal documentation, project setup, and configuration of local

development environments to support project onboarding.

Contributed to requirement analysis, architecture, coding, testing, and deployment.

Collaborated with QA, DevOps, and product teams in Agile sprints.

Established clean, modular code practices and optimized performance.



Integrated third-party APIs for the Coffee Board web app, boosting functionality and user satisfaction.

Projects

KPTCL – Meeting Management System Frontend: Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, ES6 Backend: Java17, Spring Boot, Spring JPA, SQL

Designed and developed a comprehensive full-stack application to facilitate efficient

scheduling, documentation, and management of meetings for Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Limited (KPTCL).

Developed robust backend services with Java 17, Spring Boot and integration with existing

enterprise systems.

Ensured application scalability and maintainability by adhering to clean code principles and

modular architecture.

Conducted rigorous dev testing to guarantee system reliability and user satisfaction.

Coffee Board of India – E-Commerce Platform Frontend: Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, ES6 Backend: Java17, Spring Boot, Spring JPA, SQL

Developed a government-certified e-commerce site under the Ministry of Commerce.

Contributed to internal documentation, project setup, and configuration of local

development environments to support project onboarding.

Assisted in full-stack feature development, focusing on clean architecture and reusable

components.

Contributed to frontend development using Angular and managed backend data via MS SQL

Server.

Technical Skills



Languages: Java17, SQL



Frameworks & Technologies: Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA, Hibernate, Microservices

Tools: Git, GitHub, SVN, Maven, Design Pattern

Other: RESTful APIs, Log4j, Collections framework, Data Structures & Algorithms

Education

Bachelor of Technology – Information Technology Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC) Aug 2017 – Aug 2021

Signature Aadarsh Barnwal

Date Bangalore, 20th Oct 2025
